releaseNotes: Equal-height, collapsed-by-default cards across Assignments, Teacher updates, Mail box and Overview; expand a card for full content and actions.
Automatic refresh cooldown now defaults to 30 minutes and is configurable in Settings. Manual updates and normal schedules still bypass it.
Daily shared Drive folder checks, smarter attendance caching, weekly healthy-link checks and daily failure retries reduce repeated work.
New posts and resources are still checked immediately on each sync; reused attendance keeps its original collection timestamp.
